Meet your stylist

Hi, I'm Ki — I care for hair the natural way.

I'm Kiana — everyone calls me Ki. For more than 15 years I've helped clients in Charlotte embrace, understand, and love their natural hair, without chemicals changing what makes it beautiful.

A private studio, a personal experience

Ki 2 is a private home studio on Hewitt Drive in Charlotte (28269). That means when you sit in my chair, you have my full attention — no double-booking, no noisy salon floor, no one rushing your hair.

Every appointment starts with listening: your hair history, your routine, and what you want your hair to do. Then we build a healthy-hair plan around your real life.

  • Licensed & experienced
    Licensed stylist with 15+ years behind the chair.
  • Non-chemical philosophy
    Care that works with your natural texture — not against it.
  • One-on-one in a private studio
    Quiet, relaxed, and focused entirely on you.
  • Education at every visit
    Leave knowing how to care for your hair at home, too.

The Ki 2 philosophy

Healthy hair is beautiful hair.

🌿

No harsh chemicals

Ki 2 is built on non-chemical care. We focus on moisture, strength, and gentle technique — so your natural pattern can thrive as it is.

💧

Health before style

A style should never cost you your hair. Every service starts with the condition of your hair and scalp, then we style from a place of health.

🏡

Private & unhurried

A home studio means a calmer visit. More time to talk, more care in the details, and a plan you can actually keep up between appointments.

Good to know

Questions, answered.

What does “non-chemical” hair care mean?

It means Ki 2 focuses on caring for your natural texture without chemical services that permanently alter it. The emphasis is on moisture, strength, gentle technique, and styles that protect your hair's health.

Where exactly is the studio?

Ki 2 is a private home studio on Hewitt Drive in Charlotte, NC 28269. Because it's a private studio, the exact address is shared with you when you book your appointment.

When is Ki available?

Studio hours are Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 8:00pm. The studio is closed on Saturdays and Sundays.

How do I book, and how much does it cost?

Call (980) 499-4655, email ki2naturalhaircare@gmail.com, message @Ki2NaturalHairCare on Instagram, or use the booking form above. Pricing depends on your hair and the service you need, so Ki will confirm the right option and price with you directly when you enquire.

I'm new to natural hair — where do I start?

Start with a Healthy-Hair Consultation. Ki will look at your hair's condition, talk through your routine, and build a simple plan you can actually follow — no overwhelm, no judgement.

Ready to love your natural hair?

Book a visit with Ki in Charlotte — 15+ years of experience, one chair, and all the attention your crown deserves.
